source: LXCat, www.lxcat.net (SIGLO database). SIGLO database is the electron-impact cross-section source of Chen et al., Phys. Plasmas 32, 113502 (2025), ref 22. Re-sourced from the project crossbrowser export lxcat_siglo.json, SIGLO process id SIGLO__Xe__Elastic__32.
comment: elastic momentum transfer. SIGLO dataset (Chen 2025, ref 22); re-sourced from crossbrowser lxcat_siglo.json, source id SIGLO__Xe__Elastic__32. Electron momentum-transfer (elastic) channel for ground-state Xe. SIGLO export used for electron transport (the two-term Boltzmann solve that supplies mu_e/D_e and the electron-impact rate coefficients), Chen et al. Phys. Plasmas 32, 113502 (2025), ref 22. Cross section stored in m^2 by SIGLO (converted to cm^2 for the CSV column).
